description: This file defines the XmlErrorParser class, which is responsible for parsing XML error responses in the AWS SDK for PHP. It interprets error codes, messages, and request IDs from XML error responses to facilitate error handling.

classes.name: XmlErrorParser
classes.description: A class that parses XML-formatted error responses from AWS services, extracting error details such as code, message, and request ID, and providing structured error data.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the XmlErrorParser with optional Service and XmlParser instances.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Invokes the parser on a ResponseInterface, returning structured error data.

methods.name: parseHeaders
methods.description: Parses error information from HTTP headers when the body is empty.

methods.name: parseBody
methods.description: Parses the XML body to extract error details such as code, message, and request ID.

methods.name: registerNamespacePrefix
methods.description: Registers and returns the namespace prefix for XPath queries based on the XML namespaces.

methods.name: payload
methods.description: Parses the XML error payload using the XML parser and structure shape.
